Cave Entrance.description: The mouth of a vast cave system yawns before you. Cool air carries the scent of damp stone and ancient dust.
Cave Entrance.static_description: You stand at the mouth of a vast cave system. Cool, damp air carries the scent of ancient stone and forgotten ages. A faint glow from bioluminescent fungi paints the walls in shades of ghostly blue.

Rocky Path.description: A winding path of jagged stones leads deeper into the darkness.
Rocky Path.static_description: Jagged stones pave a winding path deeper into the earth. Moisture drips from the ceiling. The air grows cooler as you descend.

Narrow Passage.description: The walls close in. You must turn sideways in places.
Narrow Passage.static_description: The passage narrows drastically. The rough stone scrapes your shoulders. Up ahead the tunnel widens again.

Goblin Cavern.description: A large cavern littered with bones and crude tools.
Goblin Cavern.static_description: This sprawling cavern bears all the marks of goblin habitation: scattered bones, crude wooden tools, and a wretched stench. Flickering shadows suggest movement in the periphery.

npcs.name: Shadow Thief
npcs.description: A shadowy figure blending in with the caverns' darkness.

Treasure Chamber.description: Gold and jewels spill from shattered chests. A golden idol sits on a stone pedestal.
Treasure Chamber.static_description: Sunlight has never touched this place yet the room glitters. Gold coins, jewels, and ancient artifacts lie heaped. A stone pedestal holds a golden idol, its eyes staring into eternity.

Ancient Vault.description: An ancient stone vault sealed for centuries. The air is dry and still.
Ancient Vault.static_description: The massive stone door groans open revealing a vault sealed for centuries. Shelves line the walls holding relics of a civilization long turned to dust. A legendary blade rests on a central altar.

Crossroads.description: Many passages converge here. Faint whispers echo from each direction.
Crossroads.static_description: Many tunnels meet at this natural junction, each promising different fates. Whispers seem to emanate from the stone itself. A weathered signpost stands at the center.

Forgotten Armory.description: Racks of rusted weapons line the walls.
Forgotten Armory.static_description: This chamber was once an armory. Most arms have rusted but a shield and helm still gleam with an oil sheen.

Underground Lake.description: A vast underground lake stretches into darkness. The water is perfectly still.
Underground Lake.static_description: A vast underground lake spreads before you, its surface like black glass reflecting bioluminescent fungi. The water is so clear you can see the stone floor far below.

Rat Tunnels.description: Low-ceilinged tunnels smelling of fur and filth.
Rat Tunnels.static_description: The ceiling is low forcing you to stoop. The stench of wet fur and guano is overwhelming. Red eyes gleam from the darkness.

Ancient Library.description: Towering shelves of petrified books line the walls.
Ancient Library.static_description: This grand library has survived the centuries barely. Towering shelves bow under the weight of countless books. A few scrolls on a central table remain intact.

Meditation Chamber.description: A circular chamber with a smooth stone floor. The acoustics are perfect.
Meditation Chamber.static_description: A perfectly circular chamber with a floor worn smooth by countless feet. Your heartbeat echoes off the walls. A stone basin in the center holds clear water.

Hidden Passage.description: A secret passage behind a false bookshelf.
Hidden Passage.static_description: The bookshelf swings open revealing a narrow passage. Dust motes dance in your torchlight. The walls are lined with faded frescoes of an ancient battle.

Dragon's Lair.description: The heat is intense. A massive form stirs in the shadows.
Dragon's Lair.static_description: The heat hits you like a physical force. An elder wyrm's scales smolder with inner fire, casting dancing shadows across walls covered in molten gold veins.

Healing Spring.description: A grotto with a crystal-clear warm pool at its center.
Healing Spring.static_description: You enter a peaceful grotto where a natural spring bubbles up from deep within the earth. The warm luminous water casts dancing reflections. A greater health potion rests beside the pool.

Verdant Cavern.description: Filled with strange phosphorescent plants pulsing with soft blue light.
Verdant Cavern.static_description: Unlike the rest of the cave system this chamber teems with life. Glowing fungi in shades of blue and violet carpet the floor. Strange flowers with silver veins bloom in the dim light.

Collapsed Tunnel.description: Partially collapsed ceiling creates a maze of rubble.
Collapsed Tunnel.static_description: An ancient collapse has transformed this passage into a treacherous maze of broken stone and twisted iron. A health potion glints between two fallen pillars.

Echoing Hall.description: A grand hall where every sound echoes impossibly.
Echoing Hall.static_description: A vast natural hall with a ceiling soaring into darkness. Your footsteps reverberate like drumbeats. Ancient murals cover the walls depicting a ritual of some kind.

Fungal Caverns.description: Towering mushrooms glow with an eerie bioluminescence.
Fungal Caverns.static_description: Mushrooms the size of houses tower around you, their caps glowing in shades of purple and teal. Spores drift through the air like tiny stars. The ground is soft with fungal matter.

Crystal Cave.description: A cave lined with quartz crystals that refract light into rainbows.
Crystal Cave.static_description: Every surface is covered with quartz crystals of every size. They catch whatever light exists and refract it into a thousand dancing rainbows. The air hums with a faint harmonic resonance.

Lava Bridge.description: A natural stone bridge spans a river of molten lava below.
Lava Bridge.static_description: The heat is suffocating. A narrow stone bridge arches over a river of molten rock that glows and pulses far below. The air shimmers with heat. On the far side a tunnel leads deeper.

Underground River.description: An underground river rushes through a wide tunnel.
Underground River.static_description: A powerful river cuts through this chamber, its waters black and swift. The current is too strong to cross without help. Along the bank you find debris washed downstream.

Deep Tunnels.description: Rough-hewn tunnels that descend deep into the earth.
Deep Tunnels.static_description: These tunnels were carved by ancient miners who sought something precious in the depths. Rusted pickaxes and broken carts line the walls. The air grows warmer as you descend.

npcs.name: Lost Soul
npcs.description: A wispy ghost floating silently above the stone floor.

Forgotten City Gates.description: Massive stone gates mark the entrance to a lost underground city.
Forgotten City Gates.static_description: Twin pillars carved with scenes of a glorious civilization frame a set of enormous iron gates. They stand slightly ajar as if awaiting your arrival. Beyond them lies a city swallowed by the earth.

npcs.name: Guardian Kael
npcs.description: A stone statue humming with ancient protective magic.

Market Ruins.description: The remains of an ancient marketplace. Stalls and carts are frozen in time.
Market Ruins.static_description: Stone stalls line what was once a bustling market square. Petrifed goods still rest on counters. A merchant's skeleton sits behind a counter, keys still clutched in its bony fingers.

Training Ground.description: An ancient training ground with weapon racks and practice dummies.
Training Ground.static_description: This chamber was clearly a training ground. Weapon racks line the walls. Practice dummies stand in rows, their straw stuffing long since rotted. A sturdy iron sword rests on a bench.

Treasury.description: A vaulted chamber filled with chests and coin piles.
Treasury.static_description: This was the city's treasury. Most chests have been looted but a few remain sealed. A single chest of dark iron catches your eye - it glows with a faint inner light.

Tomb of Kings.description: The final resting place of the city's ancient rulers.
Tomb of Kings.static_description: Sarcophagi of marble and gold line this grand tomb. Each bears the effigy of a king or queen. At the far end a crown rests on a stone pillow. The air is heavy with the weight of ages.

Ritual Chamber.description: A circular chamber with an altar at its center. Strange symbols cover the floor.
Ritual Chamber.static_description: Concentric circles of glowing runes cover the floor of this chamber. An obsidian altar stands at the epicenter. The air crackles with residual magic. Something was summoned here long ago.

Bazaar.description: A bustling underground market. Colorful tents line the walls.
Bazaar.static_description: Despite being deep underground this chamber is alive with activity. Colorful tents and stalls line the walls. A mysterious merchant sits at the center surrounded by wares from distant lands.

npcs.name: Merchant Vex
npcs.description: A cloaked merchant standing behind a stall of curiosities.

Oracle's Chamber.description: A chamber draped in silken veils. Incense hangs thick in the air.
Oracle's Chamber.static_description: Silken veils of deep purple and gold drape from the ceiling, creating an intimate sacred space. Incense burns in braziers filling the air with exotic scents. A figure sits cross-legged on a cushion at the center.

npcs.name: Oracle Mira
npcs.description: An old woman draped in silk, staring into a swirling crystal ball.

Silent Grove.description: An underground forest of pale trees that somehow thrive without sunlight.
Silent Grove.static_description: Impossibly a grove of pale silver-barked trees grows here, their leaves glowing with soft bioluminescence. The ground is carpeted with phosphorescent moss. The silence is absolute and profound.

npcs.name: Bard Lyric
npcs.description: A young bard wearing a colorful lute on his back.

Bone Pit.description: A vast pit filled with the bones of countless creatures.
Bone Pit.static_description: You stand at the edge of a massive pit filled with bones of every shape and size. They crunch and shift beneath your feet. A narrow path winds through the bonefield.

Spider Nest.description: Webs coat every surface. The walls pulse with egg sacs.
Spider Nest.static_description: Gleaming webs coat every surface of this tunnel. Egg sacs the size of your head pulse gently. The skittering of countless legs echoes from the darkness above.

Shadow Thief Lair.description: A hidden den filled with stolen trinkets and shadows.
Shadow Thief Lair.static_description: This hidden chamber is clearly the den of the Shadow Thief. Stolen goods are piled in corners: glittering jewels, ancient coins, and mysterious artifacts. A note pinned to the wall reads: 'Next: the vault.'

Escape Tunnel.description: A rough-hewn tunnel sloping upward. Fresh air!
Escape Tunnel.static_description: This tunnel slopes steeply upward, its walls rough and uneven. But it's the air that stops you - fresh, clean air carrying the scent of pine and earth. Freedom is near.

Sunlit Valley.description: You emerge into a sun-drenched valley. The world stretches before you.
Sunlit Valley.static_description: You shield your eyes as brilliant sunlight floods your vision. Green grass, towering pines, and a clear blue sky stretch before you. Birds sing. A gentle breeze carries the scent of wildflowers. You are free.

lore_entries.title: The Caverns of Whispers
lore_entries.content: The Caverns of Whispers were formed during the First Age, carved by the subterranean waters of the Styxian flow. It has served as a tomb, a refuge, and a dungeon for a thousand years.

lore_entries.title: The Goblin Horde
lore_entries.content: The Rust-Bite Goblin Clan migrated to the upper caverns fifty years ago. They worship a golden idol they stole from the tombs of the ancient kings, believing it protects them from the dragon below.

lore_entries.title: The Legendary Blade
lore_entries.content: The Legendary Blade is a sword forged from a fallen star. It was sealed with a magical lock that responds only to the Golden Idol.

lore_entries.title: Vermithrax the Smoldering
lore_entries.content: Vermithrax the Smoldering is an ancient wyrm of the deep earth. It nested in the lower thermal vents centuries ago, sleeping on a hoard of melted gold. Its heart is a source of pure elemental power.

lore_entries.title: The Tomb and the Skeleton King
lore_entries.content: The Tomb of Kings houses the sarcophagi of the obsidian dynasty. It is guarded by the Skeleton King, who still clutches the crown of black iron and silver. Only those who carry the silver key may pass into the inner sanctum.

lore_entries.title: The Under-Bazaar
lore_entries.content: The Under-Bazaar is a neutral ground where surface dwellers, deep goblins, and shadows trade. Merchant Vex coordinates trades, always seeking gold coins and ancient relics.
